classes_note: Three classes, each sourced by the field and the census: (1) training-data membership testing and inspection (B2, B9, B10; census question and area 'finding'); (2) the training corpora the artifact records, The Pile and The Stack (B2, B9; census area 'corpora', record.in_layer, relation 'uses' the-pile); (3) dataset and model documentation artifacts (B2, B9, B10; census evidence_kind). The aliases are the entity's name (case-sensitive, excluding the Du Bois book title), its host, its paper's title and its authors' surnames. The homonyms on T's rail (W. E. B. Du Bois's data portraits and the 2018 book of that title; Judith Donath's data portraits at the MIT Media Lab; Giorgia Lupi's TED 2017 Data Portraits) are distinct entities and are not aliases.
